title: New app
description: Pick where it comes from. We read the repository, suggest everything, and you confirm.

repos.noMatch: No repository matches "{{query}}". Try another name or paste its URL.
repos.partial: Some connected accounts could not be listed. Paste a URL for anything missing.
repos.emptyTitle: No git provider is connected yet
repos.emptyBody: Connect GitHub to pick a repository from a list. You can also paste any public git URL.

url.label: Repository URL
url.hint: GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Bitbucket. Files are read through the provider API, nothing is cloned yet.
url.advanced: Private repository or a specific branch?
url.tokenHint: Used once to read files and to build. Leave empty for a public repository.

git.title: Import from Git
git.description: Pick a repository and its files are read through the provider API. Nothing is cloned or created until you deploy.
git.connectBody: Connect an account to choose from your repositories, or paste a repository URL below.

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.description: Ready-made services with sane defaults. Open one to see what it deploys.
templates.unavailable: The template list is not available right now. The full catalog is one click away.

other.title: Other ways to start
other.description: Bring a container image, a compose file or a docker run command.
other.imageHint: Deploy a prebuilt image from a registry.
other.composeHint: Paste or upload a compose file.
other.runHint: Turn a command into a managed app.

warnings.nothing_detected: No Dockerfile, compose file or known framework was found. Pick the build type under Advanced.
warnings.read_budget: The file read budget was reached, so some findings may be missing.
warnings.tree_truncated: This repository is large and its file listing was cut short.
warnings.monorepo_choose_app: This looks like a monorepo with several apps. Check the app directory below.
warnings.port_unknown: No listening port could be detected. Set the port the app listens on.

build.title: Build and run
build.appHint: Several buildable apps were found. Choose the one to deploy.

env.title: Environment variables
env.none: No environment variables were declared in the repository.
env.hasDefault: Leave empty to use the app's own default
env.noValues: Only variable names are read from the repository. Values are never imported.

review.summary: This will create {{name}} from a {{framework}} repository with {{databases}} database(s), served at {{domain}}, and start its first build.
review.failedResume: The app record exists, press Deploy to continue from where it stopped.

deployLink.title: Prefilled from a link: review before deploying
deployLink.fromSource: This form was filled in by a link from {{host}}. Nothing is created until you press Deploy.
deployLink.fromUnknown: This form was filled in by a link. Nothing is created until you press Deploy.
deployLink.name: Name
deployLink.portHint: The port the app listens on inside its container.
deployLink.healthHint: Leave empty to skip the health check.
deployLink.envHint: The link names these variables. Enter your own values; they are stored as secrets.
deployLink.missingImage: The link did not include a valid image, so choose where this app comes from below.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.image: Enter an image such as ghcr.io/you/app:latest.
errors.health: The path must start with a single slash.

no_lockfile.text: No lockfile was found, so installs are not reproducible.
no_lockfile.fix: Commit your lockfile and analyze again.

multiple_dockerfiles.fix: Pick the right one under Advanced if the choice is wrong.

malformed_manifest.text: A manifest could not be parsed, so this is a best guess.
malformed_manifest.fix: Fix the JSON or TOML syntax and analyze again.

dockerfile_no_expose.text: The Dockerfile has no EXPOSE line.
dockerfile_no_expose.fix: Add EXPOSE with your port, or set the port yourself below.

monorepo_no_root_app.text: This is a monorepo with no app at its root.
monorepo_no_root_app.fix: Create one app per package below.

railpack_unsupported.text: Automatic builds do not cover this language yet.
railpack_unsupported.fix: Add a Dockerfile to the repository and analyze again.

packages.title: Workspace packages
packages.hint: This repository holds several packages. Create one app per package, each built from its own directory and redeployed only when it changes.
packages.creating: Creating the app and starting its first build...
packages.createSelected_one: Create an app for the selected package
packages.createSelected_other: Create an app for each selected package ({{count}})
packages.createSelected_zero: Create an app for each selected package
packages.envNote: Required environment variables are not asked here. Add them on each app, then redeploy.
